insert_row.doc: Insert a row into a custom hub table. Looks up the table by name or id, then calls custom_row_insert with the values array serialized as JSON. Values must be provided as an array; rejects with '_values_must_be_array' if not.

name.description: Custom table name. Falls back to id if omitted.

id.description: Custom table ID used as fallback when name is not provided

values.description: Row values to insert as an array. Also accepted via the value alias. Must be an array; non-array input is rejected.

returns.description: Inserted row data returned from custom_row_insert stored procedure

errors.message: The values parameter must be an array
errors.condition: values (or value) input is not an array

create_table.doc: Create a custom table attached to the current hub. Registers the table via custom_table_register, then executes a CREATE TABLE query built from the provided column and key definitions. Column types supported: mediumtext, enum, int, integer, float, and varchar/other string types. Key types can be PRIMARY, UNIQUE, INDEX, or empty.

name.description: Table name to register and create

columns.description: Column definitions array. Each entry requires: name (string), type (mediumtext, enum, int, integer, float, or varchar/other), value (length or enum values array), and optionally attribute (e.g. NOT NULL) and default.

keys.description: Key definitions array. Each entry requires: name (string), type (PRIMARY, UNIQUE, INDEX, or empty string for plain KEY), and optionally value (array of column names for composite keys).

returns.description: Registered table record from custom_table_register after successful CREATE TABLE execution

table_name.description: Actual table name created in the database

errors.condition: Database returns an error when executing the generated CREATE TABLE SQL

delete_table.doc: Delete a registered custom table by name. Calls custom_table_delete stored procedure with the table name.

name.description: Name of the custom table to delete

returns.description: Deletion confirmation data from custom_table_delete stored procedure

fetch.doc: Fetch rows from a custom hub table with optional column selection, filtering, ordering, and pagination. Looks up the table via custom_table_get, then executes a SELECT query with sanitized column, filter, and order clauses. Supports both page-based and limit-based result capping. Column, filter, and order tokens are sanitized to prevent injection.

name.description: Custom table name. Falls back to id if omitted.

id.description: Custom table ID used as fallback when name is not provided. Required if name is omitted.

columns.description: Columns to SELECT. Also accepted via select alias. Defaults to all columns. Each token is sanitized by stripping commas, semicolons, and spaces.

filter.description: WHERE clause tokens as an array of strings. Also accepted via where alias. Tokens are sanitized and joined with spaces.

order.description: ORDER BY clause tokens as an array of strings. Tokens are sanitized and joined with spaces.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Values <= 0 are treated as page 1. When provided, overrides limit. Offset is computed as (page - 1) * page_length.

page_length.description: Number of rows per page when using page-based pagination. Defaults to 15.

limit.description: Hard row limit for the query. Only applied when page is not set.

returns.description: Rows returned by the SELECT query on the custom table, or empty object if the table is not found

errors.message: Neither name nor id was provided
errors.condition: Both name and id inputs resolve to empty
Database returns an error when executing the generated SELECT SQL
